summary: Five churches in one family (St. Joseph, St. Mary of the Cataract, St. John de LaSalle, Prince of Peace, St. Leo). All pages are images; the p1 schedule box gives weekend and weekday Masses and p2/p5/p6/p7 give Confessions and Adoration (SJDL every Thursday, POP Chapel first Friday, St. Mary first Monday). St. Mary's Saturday 5:30 PM Mass ended Oct 10 and is excluded; an All Souls Mass at St. Leo on Nov 2 at 6 PM is recorded. No open questions.
